_comment: Structure-oriented loss presets: spatial priors about WHERE a component sits in a
structure, applied as a training-time penalty rather than an input channel.
Select with --structure_loss NAME (default 'none' = the loss is untouched), and point
--structure_presets at another file to use your own. Class names are resolved against
the active config, so a preset written for one dataset fails loudly on another.
weight       scalar multiplier on the whole term
the structure's main horizontal axis, estimated per scene from the
subset classes (e.g. the deck) so it follows the structure, not the survey
probability-weighted mean axis position of `outer` to exceed that of
`inner` by `margin`, and skips the term when either class has less than
`min_mass` of predicted probability in the batch
Only an ordering constraint is implemented. Dataset-specific presets are distributed
with the study that measured them.
